results.segment: Thank you for reporting the fault with your boiler. We have booked Carr & Sons to visit on 18 August 2026 between 12pm and 5pm.

obligations.ask: Be at home to let the engineer in

results.segment: Someone over 18 must be at home to let the engineer in. If nobody is home the visit will be recorded as a no-access and rebooked, which may take several weeks.
If the time does not suit you, call us on 0300 123 6060 at least two working days before the visit to rearrange.
The engineer will carry identification. You are welcome to ask to see it.
